participation.context: Took the pottage, paid the threepence, and named the afternoon.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Fed him and entered the threepence, and did not make a kindness of it.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Brought the bowl and the muffler.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: board at threepence for the meal he sat

story.body: You sat the meal at threepence. You said the morning was rehearsal and the afternoon was yours. You left the book of the comedy shut.
